::: {.iasi-epigraph}
*If implementation costs less and less, knowledge becomes more and more valuable.*
:::

IASI is an initiative to explore a new way of understanding and practicing engineering, in which intelligent systems are a natural part of projects and participate in their construction and evolution.

Intelligent systems can already take an effective role in activities that until now depended almost exclusively on human work, from understanding a problem and proposing solutions to building, reviewing, documenting and validating a system.

This changes where the value of engineering lies.

As implementation becomes cheaper, value shifts toward knowledge: **understanding the problem, deciding what to build, specifying it precisely, designing it and validating the result**.

IASI aims to develop **a methodology and an engineering framework for projects in which people and intelligent systems work together**, from initial conception to systems capable of evolving themselves over time.

The goal is not simply to do what we already did faster. It is to investigate **how engineering must change when intelligent systems become part of the engineering process itself**.

## Open by design {#contribute}

IASI begins as a personal initiative, but **it is not intended to be built alone or to belong to a single person, but to the community**.

Its ideas, methods and artifacts are developed openly so that others can use them, discuss them, challenge them and improve them.

**Professionals, teams and organizations are welcome to participate**, whether by contributing knowledge, proposing problems, developing new artifacts or experimenting with this way of understanding engineering.

IASI starts here. **What it becomes will also depend on those who choose to build it.**

[View IASI on GitHub →](https://github.com/iasi)
